title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity fixes and version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Maya Chen
ci_status: pass (all checks green after final rerun)
description:
Context: Multiple SDK repositories (Python, TypeScript, Go) diverged slightly in auth API surface, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies the ergonomics and behavior across SDKs to reduce cognitive load for users and eliminate subtle parity bugs observed in production (streaming reconnects and auth token refresh races).

Summary of changes: - Standardize AuthClient interface across all SDKs (single TokenProvider abstraction, support for async sync flows). - Centralize retry policy config: consistent exponential backoff defaults, max attempts, and idempotency heuristics. - Streaming API parity: all SDKs now expose a StreamReader/StreamIterator abstraction with identical semantics for partial tokens, metadata events, and end-of-stream errors. WebSocket and SSE transports share the same high-level contract. - Ergonomics improvements: simplified constructors, stronger typed request/response models (TS), context-manager support (Python), and explicit Close/Cancel helpers (Go). - Parity fixes: align edge-case behaviors (empty-final-chunk handling, early-cancel cleanup, header propagation on reconnect). - Version bumps: python 1.12.0, typescript 0.34.0, go v0.9.0.

Checklist: - [x] API design review (ENG-4821) - [x] Unit + integration tests for streaming across transports - [x] End-to-end smoke on Dedicated and Hosted (region us-west-2) - [x] Docs updates for migration notes and examples - [x] Publish changelogs and bump package versions

Migration notes: Clients using custom retry/backoff configs should switch to the new RetryPolicy object; defaults are compatible but numeric defaults tightened for better server load stability. Streaming users: migrate from legacy on_event callbacks to StreamIterator; a compatibility shim is provided for one release cycle. Auth: TokenProvider replace older refresh_token hooks; most users will be unaffected if they relied on automatic refresh.

Why this PR: Reduces repeated bugfix churn across SDKs, simplifies future feature rollout (e.g., token-bound requests, server-initiated metadata events), and improves cross-language docs and examples.

Testing: Added 96 new unit/integration tests across SDKs; performed a canary rollout of TS + Python packages to internal services for 48h with no regressions observed.

release_notes: SDKs: Unified auth TokenProvider across Python/TS/Go
Streaming: standardized StreamIterator API and added compatibility shim
Retries: introduced RetryPolicy with safer defaults
Version bumps: python 1.12.0, typescript 0.34.0, go v0.9.0
Backwards compatible: no breaking changes for most users; migration guide included
notes: This was part of a coordinated SDK rollout tied to ENG-4821 and PM-734. We scheduled package publishes in a single release window to avoid partial parity between languages.
